svg.title: Selected impact
svg.desc: 40+: AI and automation deployments at companies of 20 to 200 people; 2,770 h: saved per month in total, as reported in post-deployment case studies; -43%: cost per task on my agent orchestration platform within two weeks, first-pass rate held at 71 to 78%; 0.86: clause@1 of the legal RAG on a 234-question golden dataset, MRR 0.975
